original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 1 UUID is well-formed, non-null/non-placeholder, maps to the authorized asset identity under the applicable SMBIOS byte-order convention, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture full Type 1 into protected storage, extract and normalize UUID with version-aware byte-order handling, compare with the trusted asset reference and serial/product identity, execute the approved reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user supplies the protected reference and approves normalization/reboot plan. Core protected comparison is automatable.
safety_requirements: Protect UUID/raw Type 1 from unsecured logs or chat.
Reject all-zero, all-FF, malformed, duplicate or wrong-asset values and retain pre-normalization text.
Stop on byte-order ambiguity, exposure, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect protected Type 1/tool/SMBIOS evidence, normalize UUID under the approved rule, compare to the asset reference and repeat after reboot.
Do not alter DMI, disclose the UUID or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve asset reference/mapping, byte-order convention and evidence controls.
Resolve mapping/duplicate issues and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 1 is appropriate, but grep-only output, hidden errors, insecure transport and unprotected identifier output are insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved transport/protected storage; archive full Type 1 and tool/SMBIOS versions, normalize UUID version-aware and expose only controlled comparison status/evidence ID.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 1 script, UUID scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve raw UUID, canonical normalized value and SMBIOS byte-order rule, bind it to serial/product/asset and compare inside the protected evidence boundary across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved asset inventory, SMBIOS UUID convention and evidence policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds byte-order/version handling, null/duplicate checks and identifier protection.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Trusted UUID, convention and protected mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The same raw bytes may display differently under legacy versus current conventions; both provenance and canonicalization must be retained.

project_override_considerations: A project may use its inventory's canonical UUID representation if the SMBIOS conversion rule is documented and raw evidence remains protected.
expected_evidence: Approval, protected UUID reference/mapping, SMBIOS convention and tool versions
Protected raw/canonical pre-reboot UUID plus validity/uniqueness result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently define the UUID check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field/method are clear; missing asset reference or byte-order rule affects readiness only.

review_improvement: Prevents a syntactically valid but null, duplicated, byte-swapped or wrong-asset UUID from passing while minimizing identifier exposure.
independent_technical_reasoning: Protected evidence and user approval are readiness controls; all core steps remain software-controlled, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE applies.
